title: Swap doomscrolling for 10-minute lessons with Nibble, now $69.99 for life
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: A Nibble lifetime subscription is $69.99 (reg. $599.99). You get 10-minute lessons in 20+ topics on iPhone and Apple silicon Macs.

Ten minutes of doomscrolling leaves you with nothing. Ten minutes in Nibble leaves you with a new idea about history, art, philosophy, or money. Right now a lifetime subscription is $69.99 (reg. $599.99).

Nibble is a learning app with a 4.4-star rating from more than 27,000 App Store reviews. It splits 20+ subjects into 10-minute lessons that mix short reads with quizzes, audio, video, and games. You can also chat with AI versions of notable figures to ask follow-up questions.

Pick a guided path or jump between topics like AI, music, and personal finance. New lessons arrive every month, and the app adjusts to your preferences.

Nibble requires iOS 16 or later on iPhone, or a Mac with an M1 chip or newer. One subscription works on up to three devices. I’d put it on the home screen right where the social apps used to be. This deal is for new Nibble users only.

Get Nibble for life for $69.99 (reg. $599.99).
